preamble: Debuccalization of [g] to the voiceless glottal fricative [h] is a form of lenition. The clearest case is the Galician gheada, where /ɡ/ is realized as a voiceless back fricative, often [ħ] or [h]. The Slavic change of *g to voiced [ɦ] (Czech, Slovak, Ukrainian) is filed under g > ɦ.

examples.note: Gheada debuccalizes /ɡ/ to a voiceless back fricative, often [ħ] or [h].
